label: Finding-33
title: scale-70pc-websites: The claim drops the survey's population qualifier
description: W3Techs' figure, as relayed by Tenable (69.3%) and Imperva (over 69%), is a share of websites whose server-side language is known, not of all websites. 'used by almost 70% of websites' overstates the population. numbers.json n-70-websites 'measures' describes the population correctly; the claim text should match.

comments.author: cli-user
comments.text: Run-3: Fixed in v0.13.0: the claim now reads 'websites whose server-side language is known'.
